newsitem.title: CHINA: China foreign reserves $102.3 billion at end - Nov.
newsitem.headline: China foreign reserves $102.3 billion at end - Nov.

text.p: China's foreign reserves stood at $102.3 billion at the end of November, the People's Daily on Thursday quoted Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation Wu Yi as saying in an interview.
Officials had said China's ballooning reserves could exceed $100 billion by the end of the year.
The reserves hit $100.45 billion on November 12, soaring by $26.8 billion compared with the end of 1995. The reserves increased by $22 billion in 1995.
